surface: Global side-panel notices over Capture, Scrape, Settings and Vault
auth_mode: signed-in member selecting an organization on this device
reproduction: Open the side panel before selecting an organization. The Capture list read raises a no-workspace refusal and NoticeHost renders a fixed bottom notice.
Select an existing organization in Settings. Capture refreshes, but the original no-workspace notice persists until manually dismissed.
On a 360 by 421 panel, the stale notice overlaps the enabled Scrape Save button. The trusted pointer driver finds zero hit-tested points within that button.
expected: The no-workspace notice remains visible while no organization is selected, then retires when an active organization becomes available, including a delayed refusal that arrives after selection. Unrelated refusals remain visible.
actual: The notice store retains all notices until explicit dismissal or eviction. The selected-workspace event refreshes Capture but does not retire the resolved notice, which can cover unrelated controls.
severity: S2: a resolved notice can obstruct Save, Reset and other visible controls after ordinary workspace selection; no Source data loss is demonstrated
priority: P1: retire resolved no-workspace notices in the shared notice layer so core controls remain usable, while preserving unrelated errors

transition_history.reason: Read-only native Source diagnostic identified the fixed no-workspace notice covering Save after organization selection.
Guarded two-case regression run failed on the intended stale-notice assertions for both an existing notice and a late arrival.
The typed notice-resolution repair passed the guarded two-file, 24-test run. Independent source review and native UI retest remain pending.

closure_requirement: Guarded red-to-green notice-resolution tests, typecheck, independent source review, and a read-only native panel rerun showing that selecting a workspace removes only the resolved no-workspace notice so Save is hit-testable. No second Save input is needed.
